newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 529 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 529 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 529 contracts, compared with 1549 contracts traded overnight Thursday, according to the CBOT.
There were 10 wheat, 236 corn, 275 soybean, two oat, one corn call and five corn puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/2 cent lower, corn 1/4 to one cent lower and soybeans unchanged to 1/2 cent higher.
